Set sql to 'SELECT c.name,e.title,e.day,e.category,b.quantity FROM Booking b JOIN Customer c ON c.id=b.customer_id JOIN Event e ON e.id=b.event_id WHERE 1=1'.
Set params to an empty list.

Open a managed context for connect() as conn; clean it up on exit.
Set rows to conn.execute(sql + ' ORDER BY e.day,c.id,e.id', params).fetchall().
Return render_template('index.html', rows=rows, day=day, category=category).
